links.comparator_used: Initial prompt/rubric instructions before iterative prompt engineering guided by AI-human interrater reliability
links.outcome: AI-expert agreement (Gwet's AC1) on Weight Sensitivity Instrument items
links.effect: One item (asked if weight loss was a priority) improved from Gwet's AC1=0.56 to 0.89 after prompt engineering; three context-dependent items had persistent poor agreement (final AC1=0.42, 0.66, 0.64); 7 of 11 items had good/very good agreement across all rounds (AC1 0.71 and higher)
links.tradeoff: Required educator/researcher guidance and repeated review of feedback statements and agreement statistics; tuning was less successful for items requiring broader contextual assessment of the transcript
links.quote: One item initially showed poor agreement (Gwet's AC1=0.56), but agreement improved after prompt engineering (final Gwet's AC1=0.89).

design_hint: iterative prompt engineering guided by AI-human agreement
